job.title: [Post] Hiring: SAP BTP Integration Lead Greetings from Resource Corner! We are currently looking…

tailoring.headline: SAP BTP Integration Lead | SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring, API Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot and micro-services, designing and operating REST/OCC APIs, and building robust PIM-ERP-MDM data pipelines. Proven track record in techno-functional analysis, stakeholder collaboration, CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes deployments and agile delivery, all backed by SAP Commerce Cloud certification.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP BTP Integration Lead
cover_en.hook: I am excited about the opportunity to lead SAP BTP integration initiatives at your organization. With 5+ years of hands-on experience building and extending SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in end-to-end integration between SAP ERP, MDM and PIM systems. My proven ability to design scalable APIs and data pipelines aligns perfectly with the demands of this role.

bullets.label: Integration Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, ensuring seamless product data synchronization across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST web services and headless APIs for storefronts and third-party consumers, supporting high-volume transaction processing.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Acted as a bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams, translating requirements into user stories, functional specs and robust SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: CI/CD & Cloud Delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) using Jenkins, Docker and Kubernetes within agile DevOps workflows.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start 16 December 2026.

tailoring.why_company: Resource Corner’s focus on delivering cutting-edge SAP CX solutions powered by SAP BTP resonates with my passion for integrating complex SAP landscapes. Your commitment to innovation and cross-functional collaboration offers the ideal environment for me to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise, drive seamless ERP/MDM integrations and contribute to high-impact digital commerce projects.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud and integration experience to help Resource Corner deliver best-in-class SAP BTP solutions that accelerate client digital transformation.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce Cloud specialist with 5+ years of integration experience at Rockwell and Shell. I’m eager to discuss how I can lead SAP BTP integration projects for Resource Corner. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP BTP Integration Lead – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP BTP Integration Lead position. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have a strong background in API design, data pipeline integration and agile delivery. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
